main.description: Revoke an app the community authorized. Deletes the app's `network.habitat.space.appAccess` record, so the app can no longer read the community's spaces or act as the community until an admin authorizes it again. Requires service-auth. Requires the `community.configure` action.

org.description: DID of the community revoking the app.

clientId.description: OAuth client ID of the app to revoke.

errors.name: AppAccessNotFound
errors.description: The community has not authorized an app with this client ID.
